title: Altcoin season ‘quietly’ starting? Analysts spot three bullish indicators
summary: Crypto analysts spot early altcoin recovery signals as key metrics improve and capital rotation hints at a potential altseason in 2026.

title: CFTC no-action letter eases event contract reporting rules
summary: The CFTC issued no-action relief from certain swap reporting rules for fully collateralized event contracts as prediction market disputes widen.

title: Bank of England reconsiders strict stablecoin regime
summary: BoE weighs easing UK stablecoin caps and reserve demands after industry backlash, in a move that could decide whether GBP tokens can compete with dollar‑pegged rivals.

title: BitGo posts wider Q1 loss despite revenue more than doubling
summary: BitGo’s headline revenue figure doubled year-over-year to $3.8 billion, but a Bitcoin price decline and IPO-related costs pushed net losses to $60.7 million in the first quarter.

title: Trump’s White House weighs 250 pardons to celebrate America's 250th birthday
summary: One of the developers behind the crypto-mixing protocol Samourai Wallet has publicly expressed hopes for a pardon, along with FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried.

title: NY judge pushes back hearing for Aave’s bid to unfreeze $71M in ETH
summary: A New York judge has ordered supplemental briefings because Aave did not adequately outline how compounding losses could occur if the restraining notice remains in place.

title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto records net loss in Q1 despite sixfold revenue growth
summary: Nakamoto CEO David Bailey said the company is focused on scaling its Bitcoin treasury, services and trading strategies for the remainder of 2026.

title: Bitcoin risks slump after hitting ‘major bear market resistance’: CryptoQuant
summary: Bitcoin’s rally may reverse as its price has hit a historic resistance level and traders appear to already be taking profits, said CryptoQuant in a note on Wednesday.

title: US banks expect ‘slow, then fast’ shift to digitized finance: Moody's
summary: Traditional financial institutions are actively preparing for a surge in adoption to avoid being caught flat-footed by a sudden shift in market demand, according to Moody’s.

title: AI chatbot Claude helps man recover 5 Bitcoin after finding old seed phrase
summary: The crypto investor had Claude search through two Macs, two external hard drives, an Apple Notes export, iCloud Mail, Gmail inbox and X messages to help retrieve the Bitcoin.
